subject: Post-incident usage reconciliation and offset plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Greenlane Billing <billing@greenlane.com>, Evan Rhodes <evan.rhodes@greenlane.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 15:14:00 +0000
Subject: Post-incident usage reconciliation and proposed offset

Hi Evan / Billing team,

Thanks again for your patience while we completed the post-incident accounting review related to last week's metering incident. Our engineering & billing teams finished an itemized reconciliation; the short summary is below and the detailed CSV is attached.

Summary:
- Root cause: a cache replay edge-case during the autoscale window caused duplicate token attribution for ~0.9% of customer requests on 2027-10-02 between 01:00–03:30 UTC.
- Impact to Greenlane: inflated token consumption reported on the 2027-10 invoice by ~42,300 tokens (across multiple routes).
- Proposed remedy: one-time invoice offset equal to the overcharged amount (token units converted per your pricing tier) + a $1,200 operational goodwill credit for the disruption.

Attachments: greenlane_adjustment_summary_20271011.csv (line-by-line ledger; includes model, route, timestamp, original_tokens, duplicate_tokens, calculated_offset_usd).

Action items we need from you:
1) Please confirm you accept the proposed offset and goodwill credit.
2) If accepted, we'll send an offset agreement (DocuSign) for signature.
3) Let us know if you want the offset applied to the next invoice or issued as a standalone credit memo.

Next steps on our side: Marcus will circulate the offset calculation and Laura will coordinate the credit memo process once we get your go-ahead.

We understand any billing surprises are frustrating — we own this and want to make it right quickly.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: greenlane_adjustment_summary_20271011.csv
From: Evan Rhodes <evan.rhodes@greenlane.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Greenlane Billing <billing@greenlane.com>
Cc: Kara Jennings <kara.j@greenlane.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-incident usage reconciliation and proposed offset

Mina — thanks for the fast turnaround and the CSV, that level of detail is helpful. A few clarifying Qs before we sign anything:

- Can you confirm the per-token USD conversion used for our account tier? I want to make sure the math lines up with our contracted rate.
- For transparency, could you show the invoice line(s) that will be reduced or the credit memo format?

We prefer the offset to appear as a standalone credit memo rather than modifying the original invoice (helps our internal accounting).

If you can get me the DocuSign with the offset amount and a brief statement of the cause, I can route it internally for approvals.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Rhodes
Head of Platform Ops | Greenlane Logistics
evan.rhodes@greenlane.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Oct 2027 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Post-incident usage reconciliation and proposed offset (internal calc)

Team — attaching my working export (same rows as Mina's summary) and the offset calc in USD. Quick notes:

- We used Greenlane's committed per-token rate from the contract (tier 2): $0.00009 / token.
- Duplicate tokens identified: 42,300 -> calculated offset = 42,300 * 0.00009 = $3.807 -> rounded to $3.81.
- To keep this meaningful and avoid micro-credits, I'm recommending we apply the $3.81 as a standalone credit memo AND add the $1,200 goodwill credit Mina proposed, for a total offset of $1,203.81.

Questions for Mina: are we comfortable issuing a micro-credit + goodwill, or should we fold micro-credit into the goodwill number and issue a single $1,204 credit for cleaner bookkeeping?

Also tagging Laura for the mechanics of issuing the credit memo and whether we need a signed acknowledgment from Greenlane for audit trail.

Marcus Lin
Billing Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: greenlane_adjustment_working_export_20271008.csv
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Rhodes <evan.rhodes@greenlane.com>, Greenlane Billing <billing@greenlane.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 19:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-incident usage reconciliation and proposed offset — agreement and next steps

Thanks Evan — appreciate the quick review.

TL;DR: We will issue a standalone credit memo for $1,203.81 and send a brief acknowledgement DocuSign for your records. 

Details / decisions:
- Per Marcus's calc, the raw metering overcount is ~$3.81. To avoid micro-credit bookkeeping we are consolidating that into a single standalone credit memo together with the $1,200 goodwill; total = $1,203.81.
- Credit type: standalone credit memo (not rewriting the original invoice).
- DocuSign: I have prepared a short acknowledgement statement and uploaded it — DocuSign link below. Please sign when you have a minute; once signed Laura will generate the credit memo and apply it to your account.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/embedded/123e4567-offset-agreement
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/GL-9347 (notes and attached ledger).

Next steps for Greenlane:
1) Sign the DocuSign (accepts the stated offset and acknowledges the cause).
2) Reply to this thread confirming 'apply as credit memo' or say if you'd rather the credit apply to next invoice (we will default to credit memo).

Internal next steps:
- Marcus: please hand the final amount to Laura for credit memo issuance when DocuSign returns signed.
- Monica: prepare a short incident note for our account file (2–3 bullet summary) so we have audit trail.

Thanks again — sorry for the disruption and thanks for being collaborative on the fix.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: offset_terms_docusign_20271011.pdf
